description: Chicorée registry: availability, traffic, content, security, operations and registryd runtime.

panels.title: Registry
panels.description: registryd answered the web app's health check on the last scrape.

panels.title: Web app
panels.description: Prometheus could scrape /api/metrics.

panels.title: Clair
panels.description: Clair indexer reachable (0 when scanning is disabled).

panels.title: registryd version
panels.description: Build version stamped into registryd (dev for local builds).

panels.title: Pulls today
panels.description: Manifest pulls since midnight UTC.

panels.title: Storage, physical
panels.description: Deduplicated bytes on the storage backend.

panels.title: Storage, logical
panels.description: Sum of every repository's referenced blobs.

panels.title: Dedup savings
panels.description: 1 − physical ÷ logical.

panels.title: Egress and ingress
panels.description: Bytes registryd moves per second. Redirected egress is what clients fetch from S3 / the CDN after a 307.

panels.title: Top repositories by egress, selected range
panels.description: Bytes served per repository over the dashboard time range (from the web app's traffic accounting).

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95
panels.description: Metadata routes only (manifest, tags, referrers, catalog); blob transfers depend on the client's bandwidth.

panels.title: Rate limited (429)
panels.description: Pull requests refused by the rate limit, per second.

panels.title: Rate limits configured
panels.description: Effective pull limits (Administration → Rate limits, else the environment).

panels.title: Pulls and pushes per day
panels.description: Registry events per UTC day (one bar per day; widen the time range to see history).

panels.title: Largest repositories
panels.description: Logical size: sum of the blobs each repository references.

panels.title: Egress today
panels.description: Streamed plus redirected bytes since midnight UTC.

panels.title: Findings by severity
panels.description: Across every scanned manifest.

panels.title: Blocked images
panels.description: Manifests the pull policy currently refuses.

panels.title: Jobs, last run
panels.description: Outcome of the most recent run per maintenance job.

panels.title: Since last GC
panels.description: Time since the last successful garbage collection.

panels.title: Failing webhooks
panels.description: Enabled webhooks whose last delivery failed.

panels.title: Proxy orgs failing
panels.description: Enabled proxy organizations whose last upstream contact failed.

panels.title: Staging free
panels.description: Free space on the filesystem holding in-progress uploads.

panels.title: Web scrape duration
panels.description: Time the web app spends computing /api/metrics from the database.
